summary: Implemented ten independently styled dashboard theme systems in one Flutter app with an in-app theme gallery.
Shared member identity, QR, membership/payment context, Attendance/Workout/Payment/Body tabs and contextual rail remain common across themes.
Added theme-specific canvas/surface palettes, gradients, borders, shadows, geometry, decorative PNG artwork and theme-aware Android status/navigation bar styling.
Added attendance donut summary, present/late/absent/off counts, streak/trophy indicators and native date grid; Sunday and holiday use neutral styling.
Registered complete assets/ directory and reused existing avatar, 3D badge, promo, dumbbell and theme artwork.
Added widget coverage for ten theme selections, tab/rail navigation, 360dp and 320dp compact viewport.

deploymentArchitecture.criticalNetworkClarification: Tailscale membership/API/peer-online status does not itself grant ADB control. Runner must be joined to the same tailnet with ACL permission AND the phone must independently expose a reachable authenticated ADB transport. Tailscale API is control-plane metadata, not a remote shell or ADB command executor.
forbiddenAssumptions: Laptop exists or can act as a bridge
safety: Never expose ADB publicly or port-forward it
Never claim install/launch/screenshot without fresh runner evidence
nextEngineeringWork: Issue #6 is the active implementation specification: laptop-free phone-side authenticated command channel over cellular/Tailscale, with explicit Android consent and ADB as optional transport.
Inspect Android platform constraints for an approved phone-side deployment/bootstrap mechanism that works without Wi-Fi and without a laptop.
Determine whether the existing installed BAD GYM package can safely host an authenticated update-check/deployment component; do not assume an ordinary app can silently self-install APKs.
Provide a first-time, user-approved provisioning path if required; preserve existing BAD GYM data and package identity.
Implement a private authenticated device heartbeat/current-endpoint registration path and validate actual ADB transport from the Tailscale runner.
Replace static ANDROID_DEVICE_PORTS_JSON only after end-to-end endpoint discovery tests.
Implement queued/deferred deployment, bounded retries, per-device locks, install/launch/screenshot/log evidence and durable handoff.
deploymentArchitecture.note: Authoritative requirement and status, not a claim that phone-side agent, endpoint discovery, or unattended installation is already implemented.
